voxy.config.title: Voxy
voxy.config.general.serviceThreads.toolt: Number of threads the ServiceThreadPool can use
voxy.config.general.useSodiumBuilder.too: Uses sodium builder threads as part of voxys thread pool, can reduce stuttering and lag when moving quickly at high render distance
voxy.config.general.ingest.tooltip: Enables or disables voxies ability to convert new chunks into LoDs
voxy.config.general.showJoinMessage.tool: Show version and credit information whenever joining a server or world; disable it here
voxy.config.general.earthCurveRatio.tool: 0 disables curvature; larger values produce a stronger curve beyond the vanilla chunk boundary.
voxy.config.general.subDivisionSize.tool:
Adjusts terrain and dedicated model detail. Move right for higher precision; level 4, Standard, is the default.
Lower levels select coarse meshes earlier for Domum, opaque Copycat/LittleTiles, trains, bogeys, tracks, contraptions and kinetic parts, and reduce wire segments. Higher levels retain detail at greater GPU cost. Dedicated coarse meshes share terrain section boundaries and subdivision rules. Nearby/handoff meshes stay complete; zooming in or increasing resolution restores detail.
Coarse transitions can change silhouette, texture or lighting detail. Prebaking levels adds bake time and CPU/GPU memory use. Dedicated translucent meshes only use safe coplanar merging; beams and lasers retain minimal shapes. Sable retains native full geometry, with quality affecting only tiny-object culling.
Subdivision values: 1024, 768, 512, 256, 123, 64, 28. Existing values map to the nearest level.
voxy.config.general.renderDistance.toolt: Render distance of voxy in chunks
voxy.config.general.renderPressure.toolt: Controls Voxy's per-frame LOD build pressure, including top-level node processing rate and render-thread model baking budget. Lower values prioritize FPS and reduce stutter while moving; higher values make LODs catch up faster. This option is hot-reloadable.
voxy.config.general.lodBoundaryFade.tool:
Gradually blends normal and distant terrain to soften the transition. Water uses a separate transition.
Risk: the blend may show grain or flicker. Disable when your shader pack already provides distant-terrain fading (such as Photon), to avoid duplicate fading or shadow boundaries. This improves appearance, not necessarily FPS.
voxy.config.general.lodBoundaryFadeLengt:
Sets the blend width in blocks. Requires smooth terrain blending.
Tradeoff: wider blends soften the transition but may spread grain or flicker over a larger area. Narrower blends make the transition more noticeable.
voxy.config.general.lodBoundaryInset.too:
Moves the outer blend edge toward the player by this many blocks, placing the transition where normal terrain is more likely to be loaded and reducing edge gaps. Requires smooth terrain blending.
Tradeoff: larger values bring simplified distant terrain closer; smaller values may expose seams near unloaded terrain.
voxy.config.general.environmental_fog.to: Enables or disables voxy rendering environmental fog
voxy.config.general.ssao_mode.tooltip: The mode used for screenspace ambient occlusion (Auto attempts to pick the best option while reducing performance impact)
voxy.config.general.adaptCloudDistance.t: Enables or disables adaptive cloud distance
voxy.config.general.cloudDistance.toolti: Cloud distance in chunks, up to 128 (used when adaptive cloud distance is disabled)
voxy.config.general.fogIntensity.tooltip: Intensity of the fog, higher values make the fog thicker and reduce visibility
voxy.config.general.fogDensity.tooltip: Shapes the fog falloff curve - higher values make the transition more extreme (clear up close, ramping up sharply near the fog distance). 0 is a uniform linear fade
voxy.config.general.skyFogDistance.toolt: End distance for sky and LOD terrain fog, in chunks
voxy.config.general.fog_distance.tooltip: Scales voxy's LOD fog distance (100% = fog reaches full at the render edge). Higher = see further before the distant LOD fades to the sky colour.
voxy.config.fakesight.enabled.tooltip: Requests more chunks for Voxy, up to 48 chunks. Higher distances increase CPU, memory, network and save load.
voxy.config.fakesight.distance.tooltip: Request radius up to 48 chunks. High values substantially increase CPU, memory, network and world-generation load.
voxy.config.farEntities.players.tooltip:
Render lightweight player snapshots beyond vanilla entity range. Multiplayer requires Voxy on the server; SeeU takes precedence when installed.
Requires Neo Voxy support on the server. Disabled for unsupported connections without changing your saved preference.
voxy.config.farEntities.vehicles.tooltip:
Independently controls boats, minecarts, mounts and other entities ridden by distant players. Disabling it also stops vehicle snapshots from being sent.
Requires Neo Voxy support on the server. Disabled for unsupported connections without changing your saved preference.
voxy.config.farEntities.names.tooltip:
Shows name tags above distant player proxies.
Requires Neo Voxy support on the server. Disabled for unsupported connections without changing your saved preference.
voxy.config.farEntities.animationDistanc:
Only animate distant players inside this range. Set to 0 to follow the LOD render distance.
Requires Neo Voxy support on the server. Disabled for unsupported connections without changing your saved preference.
voxy.config.farEntities.sharePosition.to:
Allow other Voxy clients on the same server to receive your distant-player snapshot.
Requires Neo Voxy support on the server. Disabled for unsupported connections without changing your saved preference.
voxy.config.compat.sableLod.tooltip: Keep simulated contraptions (ships, vehicles) rendered out to LOD distances instead of only within vanilla render distance
voxy.config.compat.sableLodDistance.tool: Maximum distant contraption render distance in chunks. Follow LOD uses Voxy's LOD radius.
voxy.config.compat.distantTrains.tooltip:
Keep Create trains (including bogey wheels) rendered beyond entity range, out to LOD distances. Requires voxy on the server
Requires Neo Voxy support on the server. Disabled for unsupported connections without changing your saved preference.
voxy.config.compat.distantTracks.tooltip: Render Create's track network beyond render distance using the tracks' real models (addon tracks like monorails included, plus bezier girders). Reads the client-synced track graph, no server support needed
Max render distance (chunks) for distant trains. Follow LOD = use voxy's LOD radius. Lower cuts GPU load; on the integrated server (singleplayer / LAN host) it also shrinks the server's pose-stream window, saving bandwidth
Requires Neo Voxy support on the server. Disabled for unsupported connections without changing your saved preference.
Max render distance (chunks) for the distant track network. Follow LOD = use voxy's LOD radius
voxy.config.compat.distantContraptions.t:
Hold a static snapshot of contraptions (bearings/pistons/gantries/minecart) the player passed, or render still-loaded ones live, out in the LOD. Client-side, no server needed
Without server-side Neo Voxy, locally captured static snapshots remain available, but remote live poses cannot be synchronized.
voxy.config.compat.distantContraptionDis: Max render distance (chunks) for distant contraptions. Follow LOD = use voxy's LOD radius
voxy.config.compat.distantBeacons.toolti: Draw beacon beams beyond vanilla's range using Voxy's stored terrain, including chunks not loaded this session
voxy.config.compat.distantBeaconDistance: Maximum beacon-beam distance in chunks. Follow LOD uses Voxy's LOD radius
voxy.config.compat.distantKinetics.toolt: Cull placed kinetic machine moving parts (rotating shafts/gears) beyond the render distance so they stop floating over the LOD. Off = Create renders them natively (may float)
voxy.config.compat.kineticEnclosedCullin: Globally render-cull shafts that are enclosed with opaque blocks on both axis ends
voxy.config.compat.distantPowerGridWires: Cache seen PowerGrid hanging wires as simplified distant meshes and keep them visible beyond entity tracking range. Active only when PowerGrid is installed.
voxy.config.compat.distantPowerGridWireD: Maximum PowerGrid wire LOD distance in chunks. Follow LOD uses Voxy's LOD radius.
voxy.config.compat.distantCopycats.toolt: Build dedicated multi-material, slope, and cogwheel LOD meshes for Create and Copycats+ blocks.
voxy.config.compat.distantCopycatsDistan: Maximum copycat-block LOD distance in chunks. Follow LOD uses Voxy's LOD radius.
voxy.config.compat.distantSimulatedLaser: Keep Simulated laser-pointer beams visible beyond block-entity render distance. Active only when Simulated is installed.
Maximum Simulated laser LOD distance in chunks. Follow LOD uses Voxy's LOD radius.
voxy.config.compat.distantFramedBlocks.t: Render framed blocks and their camouflage materials in the Voxy LOD. Active only when FramedBlocks is installed.
voxy.config.compat.distantFramedBlocksDi: Maximum FramedBlocks LOD distance in chunks. Follow LOD uses Voxy's LOD radius.
voxy.config.compat.distantLittleTiles.to: Render cached LittleTiles microblock meshes beyond vanilla view distance. Active only when LittleTiles is installed.
voxy.config.compat.distantLittleTilesDis: Maximum LittleTiles LOD distance in chunks. Follow LOD uses Voxy's LOD radius.
voxy.config.compat.distantDomum.tooltip: Render detailed Domum Ornamentum decorative models in the LOD. Active only when Domum Ornamentum is installed.
Maximum distance for detailed Domum Ornamentum LOD models in chunks. Follow LOD uses Voxy's LOD radius.
voxy.config.compat.esSnowLod.tooltip: Recolor LOD terrain with Ecliptic Seasons snow cover. Applies to newly ingested chunks
voxy.config.compat.esLodAutoReload.toolt: Automatically re-import region LODs when the season changes so distant snow cover stays current
voxy.config.compat.esReloadOnSeasonChang: Rebuild the LOD renderer when the season changes so already-loaded LODs recolor immediately
voxy.join.copyGroup: Click to copy the group number
voxy.join.openRepo: Click to open the GitHub repository
voxy.join.disableHint: This join message can be disabled from Neo Voxy in Sodium Video Settings.
voxy.join.upgradeCleanup: [Neo-Voxy] If an update causes problems, delete the Neo-Voxy configuration file and the world's Voxy cache, then try again.
voxy.config.general.leafLodMode.tooltip: Controls distant leaf rendering. Fast uses opaque foliage. Balanced uses stable per-block texture rotations, culls hidden internal faces, and keeps irregular mip-aware cutouts at medium impact. Quality preserves fine cutout detail at higher GPU cost.
voxy.config.experimental.hiZCompute.tool:
Uses a compute shader to build depth levels in batches, helping skip hidden distant terrain and potentially reducing GPU occlusion work.
Risk: gains depend on the GPU and driver; FPS may stay the same or decrease. Compilation failures automatically use the original method and show one chat warning. Disable if visual issues persist. Saving rebuilds the renderer and may briefly stutter.
voxy.experimental.hiZCompute.fallback: [Neo-Voxy] Experimental Hi-Z shader compilation failed; using the draw-chain Hi-Z fallback.
voxy.config.general.biomeBlendRadius.too: Smooths LOD water colours across biome borders. Range 0–7; changing it rebuilds the renderer.
voxy.config.general.biomeBlendGrass.tool: Also applies biome colour blending to grass and foliage; this increases mesh rebuild work for affected sections.
voxy.config.general.lodLiteShading.toolt:
Uses simplified distant-terrain programs supplied by the shader pack to reduce lighting and material work. May improve FPS when limited by the GPU.
Risk: lighting or material detail may decrease, and nearby and distant terrain may look different. Gains depend on the shader pack and GPU. Requires explicit shader-pack support; missing support or loading failures use the standard path. Off by default. Saving reloads shaders and the renderer and may briefly stutter.

voxy.config.experimental.cmdListHold.too:
Reuses drawing data while the camera and distant terrain are unchanged, which may improve stationary FPS.
Risk: occlusion changes and newly available terrain may appear later. Movement or terrain data updates force a rebuild. Disable if you see flicker or delayed updates. Applies when saved.
voxy.config.experimental.cmdListHoldMaxF:
Forces a distant-terrain update at least every N frames while still. Default: 4. Requires Reduce work while still.
Tradeoff: larger values save more work but may delay occlusion and terrain updates; smaller values update sooner but save less work. Applies when saved.
Reuses the overlap mask between normal and distant terrain when visible chunks, camera and projection are unchanged, saving repeated drawing work.
Risk: disable if seams show ghosting, flicker or incorrect occlusion. Automatically bypassed with temporal anti-aliasing (TAA) shader packs, so it provides no benefit there. Applies when saved.
voxy.config.experimental.sectionArrayPoo:
Keeps reusable terrain working memory to reduce allocation stutter during flight and terrain loading. Default: 100 MiB.
Tradeoff: a larger cache may reduce allocations but uses more memory and can worsen stutter when memory is scarce. A smaller cache saves memory but may require more allocations. This is not saved terrain capacity or an upfront allocation. Lowering the limit releases excess cached memory when saved.
voxy.config.experimental.opaqueNearFirst:
Tries to draw nearby opaque distant terrain first, so the GPU can skip work on terrain behind it. May improve FPS in complex scenes.
Risk: this is an approximate order. Depending on the scene and GPU, FPS may stay the same or decrease. Disable if performance worsens. Saving rebuilds the renderer and may briefly stutter.
voxy.config.experimental.chunkMaskHalfRe:
Calculates overlap between normal and distant terrain at lower resolution to reduce GPU work, using about a quarter as many mask pixels.
Risk: seams may show small gaps, overlap or flicker, especially with temporal anti-aliasing (TAA) shader packs. This does not guarantee four times the FPS. Disable if seams look wrong. Saving rebuilds the renderer and may briefly stutter.
